final.spoken: Stop doing sleep math. "If I sleep now, I get five hours." Checking the clock keeps your mind busy. Turn it around. Stand up, dim lamp, read ten minutes. Sleep comes when you stop chasing it. Follow for calmer nights.

final.why: Names a private habit every bad sleeper has, so the viewer recognises themselves in the first second.

final.hook: Your bed is teaching you to stay awake.
final.spoken: Your bed is teaching you to stay awake. Lie there worrying, and your brain links bed with awake. The fix: if you can't sleep after about twenty minutes, get up. Dim light, quiet book. Return when sleepy. Make your bed mean one thing. Follow.

final.hook: Why are you wide awake the second you lie down?
final.spoken: Why are you wide awake the second you lie down? All day your bed meant scrolling, work and worry. Tonight give it one job. Phone charges in the kitchen. Last ten minutes: lamp, paper, nothing glowing. Save this for tonight.
final.why: Answers a question the viewer has asked themselves, then gives one change for tonight.
